column3: L2/L3 selectable transaction implementation already exists and validates: L2 has privilege/sv39/timer/interrupt/atomic-mmio/shutdown/all; L3 has boot/mmu/process/timer/storage/atomic/interrupt/shutdown/all. Directed cases are diagnostic evidence only; all is required for each complete layer. Default conjunction remains L0+L1+L2+L3; Ubuntu remains explicit-only and was not launched.
